info.title: What is category B license?
info.description: Category B is the standard car driving license in Denmark, allowing you to drive regular passenger cars. It is the most popular license category and your path to freedom on the road.

features.title: Drive cars up to 3,500 kg
features.text: With a category B license, you may drive regular passenger cars with up to 8 seats in addition to the driver.

features.title: Trailer allowed
features.text: You may tow a light trailer as long as the total weight does not exceed 3,500 kg.

features.title: Minimum age: 16 years and 9 months
features.text: You must be 17 years old to obtain a category B license, but you can start the training at 16 years and 9 months.

info.closing: At Lønbæks Driving School, we guide you safely through the entire process – from theory classes to the day you receive your license. Start your journey today!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.

items.question: How long does it take to get a driver's license?
items.answer: It depends on how quickly you complete theory and driving lessons, but most students finish within 3–6 months.

items.question: Do you offer both manual and automatic cars?
items.answer: Yes, we provide lessons in both manual and automatic vehicles.

items.question: Can I get a license if I am under 18?
items.answer: Yes, you can start theory and driving lessons at 17, but the practical test can only be taken at 18.

items.question: What documents should I bring to the first lesson?
items.answer: Bring valid ID, a passport photo, and your health insurance card. If you have previous licenses or certificates, bring those as well.

items.question: How do the tests work?
items.answer: You must pass both a theory test and a practical driving test. We prepare you thoroughly for both.

items.question: Can I pay in installments?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans so you can split the cost without extra fees.

items.question: What happens if I fail the first time?
items.answer: No worries! You can retake the test, and we offer extra lessons to ensure you're ready next time.

items.question: Do you offer weekend lessons?
items.answer: Yes, we offer weekend classes so you can take lessons even if you have school or work during weekdays.
